dialogues.jp: 「とは言ってもな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, what am I gonna do?"
dialogues.text: "Well, what am I gonna do?"

dialogues.jp:
ぼんやりと窓辺の日向に｛たたず／佇｝みながら、グラウン
ドを見下ろす。
dialogues.en:
I stare blankly down at the field, standing by a sunny
window.
dialogues.text:
I stare blankly down at the field, standing by a sunny
window.

dialogues.jp:
当たり前ながら、自由参加の時点で主催者側に
回らない学生が帰っていく。
dialogues.en:
It's obvious that the students who don't participate in the
event are going home now.
dialogues.text:
It's obvious that the students who don't participate in the
event are going home now.

dialogues.jp:
かく言う俺も、別段これといってやることもな
く、部活にも入っていないので強制される作業
もない。
dialogues.en:
I have no specific duties to do, because I don't belong to
any club or team.
dialogues.text:
I have no specific duties to do, because I don't belong to
any club or team.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ふと、下にさくらがいることに気づいた。
dialogues.en: I suddenly see Sakura down there.
dialogues.text: I suddenly see Sakura down there.

dialogues.jp: 「……なにやってるんだアイツ？」
dialogues.en: "What is she doing there?"
dialogues.text: "What is she doing there?"

dialogues.jp:
誰が置いた物か、猫のエサであろう魚を、白猫
と一緒に覗き込んでいる。
dialogues.en:
She and her white cat are staring at the fish, which
somebody must have left there.
dialogues.text:
She and her white cat are staring at the fish, which
somebody must have left there.

dialogues.jp:
ここからでは声までは聞こえないが、“にゃ〜”
“うにゃ〜”と呟いているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I can't hear anything up here, but the cat must be crying
like 'meow, meow'.
dialogues.text:
I can't hear anything up here, but the cat must be crying
like 'meow, meow'.

dialogues.jp:
そして、なにか真剣な顔で猫に話し掛けている
ような……って、まさか。
dialogues.en: I also see she is talking seriously to the cat... No way!
dialogues.text: I also see she is talking seriously to the cat... No way!

dialogues.jp: 「食う気かアイツ……」
dialogues.en: "Giving that stuff to her cat...?!"
dialogues.text: "Giving that stuff to her cat...?!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お兄ちゃん発見」
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see you, oniichan!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see you, oniichan!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Meow?"
dialogues.text: "Meow?"

dialogues.jp:
目線をあげて、ぱたぱた、とさくらが手を振っ
てきた。
dialogues.en: Sakura waves her hand looking up here.
dialogues.text: Sakura waves her hand looking up here.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.jp:
小さく手を振って、愛想笑いを浮かべたまま廊
下に身をひいた。
dialogues.en:
I give her a little wave with a flattering smile, then go
back inside the hallway.
dialogues.text:
I give her a little wave with a flattering smile, then go
back inside the hallway.

dialogues.jp: 「やばいやばい……」
dialogues.en: "Darn it!"
dialogues.text: "Darn it!"

dialogues.jp:
君子危うきに近寄らずというか、俺、さくらに
近寄らずと言うか。
dialogues.en:
A wise man never courts danger, which means I shouldn't get
closer to Sakura.
dialogues.text:
A wise man never courts danger, which means I shouldn't get
closer to Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「やはり帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "Should I go home?"
dialogues.text: "Should I go home?"

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで油を売ってるよりは、家に帰っ
て寝てしまうほうがいくらか健康的だ。
dialogues.en:
I think it's much healthier to take a nap at home than fool
around here.
dialogues.text:
I think it's much healthier to take a nap at home than fool
around here.

dialogues.jp:
中身のない鞄を肩にかついで、自主的に一足早
い春休みに入ることにする。
dialogues.en:
Carrying my empty bag over my shoulder, I decide to get an
early start on spring break by myself.
dialogues.text:
Carrying my empty bag over my shoulder, I decide to get an
early start on spring break by myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さんどこ行くの？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, where are you going, niisan?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, where are you going, niisan?"

dialogues.jp:
とことこ、と俺が時間を潰しているうちに、教
室から音夢が出てきた。
dialogues.en: As I walk around, Nemu comes out of her classroom.
dialogues.text: As I walk around, Nemu comes out of her classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「帰るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今回はなにもしないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you doing anything for the event this time?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you doing anything for the event this time?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「して欲しいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「騒ぎしか起こしそうにないので、是非しない
　でください」
dialogues.en: "Please don't, because I know you'll cause trouble."
dialogues.text: "Please don't, because I know you'll cause trouble."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな……」
dialogues.en: "That's what I thought."
dialogues.text: "That's what I thought."

dialogues.jp: 笑顔で｛けんせい／牽制｝をかけてくる音夢のおでこを押す。
dialogues.en: I push Nemu's forehead when she warns me with a smile.
dialogues.text: I push Nemu's forehead when she warns me with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「お前は風紀委員会の仕事か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you working on the discipline committee?"
dialogues.text: "Are you working on the discipline committee?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、準備をきっちりやっておかないと、な
　にが起こるか分からないし」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. We have to get ready for that, because you never know
what could happen on the day."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. We have to get ready for that, because you never know
what could happen on the day."

dialogues.jp:
俺の手をどかして、ちょっと寂しげに音夢が微
笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles wanly, pushing my hand away.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles wanly, pushing my hand away.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当日も、遊んでいる暇なんてないでしょうね」
dialogues.en: "I don't think I'll have time to enjoy myself on the day."
dialogues.text: "I don't think I'll have time to enjoy myself on the day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大変だな」
dialogues.en: "It must be hard."
dialogues.text: "It must be hard."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ。今回はブラックリストに載っている
　兄さんが何もしないだけ、まだ楽ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Not really, because someone like you who's on the blacklist
isn't participating this time, which makes it much easier."
dialogues.text:
"Not really, because someone like you who's on the blacklist
isn't participating this time, which makes it much easier."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.jp:
藪からヤマタノオロチが出てきそうなので、顔
を合わせないように深く頷く。
dialogues.en:
I nod deeply, to avoid seeing the girl appearing from the
shrubs.
dialogues.text:
I nod deeply, to avoid seeing the girl appearing from the
shrubs.

dialogues.jp: 「あんまり頑張るなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't work too hard!"
dialogues.text: "Don't work too hard!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前は遠足の前日に興奮で眠れなくて、当日
　を駄目にするタイプだからな」
dialogues.en:
"Don't you remember that one time you ruined the field trip,
because you were so excited that you couldn't sleep the
night before?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't you remember that one time you ruined the field trip,
because you were so excited that you couldn't sleep the
night before?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい……了解しました」
dialogues.en: "Yes, I know that."
dialogues.text: "Yes, I know that."

dialogues.jp:
いまいち反省のない音夢に肩をすくめて、玄関
に向かおうとする。
dialogues.en:
I shrug at Nemu, who never was one for thinking things over,
and then walk to the entrance.
dialogues.text:
I shrug at Nemu, who never was one for thinking things over,
and then walk to the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん！」
dialogues.en: "Niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan!"

dialogues.jp: その背に声がかかった。
dialogues.en: She calls me right on cue.
dialogues.text: She calls me right on cue.

dialogues.jp:
裏モードの音夢には珍しく、ちょっとはしゃぎ
気味な感じで。
dialogues.en: She sounds as hyper as another girl I know.
dialogues.text: She sounds as hyper as another girl I know.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「卒業パーティー、楽しみ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you looking forward to the graduation party?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking forward to the graduation party?"

dialogues.jp: 軽く天井を見上げて考える。
dialogues.en: I think carefully, looking at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I think carefully, looking at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 「面倒だけど……まぁな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, but it's a pain in the neck, though."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, but it's a pain in the neck, though."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。私、頑張るからね！」
dialogues.en: "I know. I'll work on it much harder!"
dialogues.text: "I know. I'll work on it much harder!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、頑張るなよ」
dialogues.en: "But I told you not to work harder!"
dialogues.text: "But I told you not to work harder!"

dialogues.jp:
思わずにやける口元を隠すように、背中越しに
軽く手を振って別れた。
dialogues.en:
I set off home, giving her a little wave as I walk away,
hiding a grin on my face.
dialogues.text:
I set off home, giving her a little wave as I walk away,
hiding a grin on my face.

dialogues.jp: ◆やる気な音夢さん◆
dialogues.en: ◆Determined Nemu-san◆
dialogues.text: ◆Determined Nemu-san◆

dialogues.jp:
帰ろうとしたところで猫の餌に魅入るさくらを
目撃し、さらに音夢に呼び止められる。
dialogues.en:
When I was about to go home, I saw Sakura watching the cat's
food, and after that, Nemu held me up.
dialogues.text:
When I was about to go home, I saw Sakura watching the cat's
food, and after that, Nemu held me up.

dialogues.jp:
風紀委員は見回りなど、何かと忙しいらしいが、
張り切り過ぎるなと音夢に釘をさす。
dialogues.en:
I know the discipline committee is very busy with patrols,
so I warn Nemu not to work too hard.
dialogues.text:
I know the discipline committee is very busy with patrols,
so I warn Nemu not to work too hard.

dialogues.jp:
だが、俺が卒パを楽しみだと聞き、ますます張
り切ってしまう音夢だった。
dialogues.en:
But after I said I was looking forward to the graduation
party, she seemed to work much harder on it.
dialogues.text:
But after I said I was looking forward to the graduation
party, she seemed to work much harder on it.
